definitions.explanation: Hair that grows on the human body, excluding head hair and facial hair. Includes arm hair, leg hair, chest hair, etc.

examples.japanese: {体毛|たいもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧。
{体毛|たいもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いろいろな⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are various methods for removing body hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体毛|たいもう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{進化|しんか}→進化：06029_shinka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body) and {毛|もう} (hair, fur). A neutral, slightly formal term. In everyday conversation, people more often refer to specific types of body hair.

- {体毛|たいもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧: to have thick/dense body hair
- {体毛|たいもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: to have thin/sparse body hair
- {体毛|たいもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: body hair removal
